evidence.quote: Independent Crowdfunded Community Cinema Based in East London

findings.value: A cinema that runs recurring Pitchblack Playback album listening nights on its sound system, plus a Live strand and music documentary festival screenings.

evidence.quote: Immerse yourself in one of the best albums of the 21st century at Pitchblack Playback's 10th anniversary listening session in the dark.
No phones; no talking; no singing; no distractions; just you and the music.
Endless Night (1972) + The Swinging Christies LIVE!
Doc 'n' Roll: HEAVEN 17: THE LAST TEMPTATION + Director Q&A
through our powerful cinema sound system
